BUG FOUND (core, not mine to fix): a column marked classes: 'default' that is ALSO navigated to hides itself - Page.css '.page-column-pages:has(> .page:is(.active-page,.active-ancestor)) > .page.default { display: none }' matches the default page against itself once the Router marks it, and the whole branch goes blank. Reverted; noted in gallery/doc/decisions.md.

BUG FOUND (View, not mine to fix): View.href(undefined) falls into attr()'s GETTER branch and returns null, so any chain after it dies. ext/demo's preview override does .href(nav.url).attr('aria-label', ...) and throws on a url-less nav. Suggested fix: href(url){ return url === undefined ? this : this.attr('href', url); }

assign.outcome:
**Cross-page previews answered, proven, and turned into a gallery.** You can import any `page.js` from anywhere and draw its card — here is exactly what that costs and what it cannot do, each answer with a live demo.

- [The Gallery](/imagine/gallery/) — browsable lists of everything, every card a foreign page
- [The four answers](/imagine/gallery/answers/) — each with the demo that settles it
- [core/Page/doc/previews.md](/framework/core/Page/doc/previews/) — the write-up

**1 · Yes, and one import is a whole subtree.** 19 JS modules and 3 permanent `<head>` stylesheets for one page with five children, 21ms. What comes back is an orphan — `parent` and `app` undefined — which is enough for `preview()`/`nav()`/`link()` and not enough for `activate()`. ⚠ Never `add()` it: `move()` rewrote `/framework/styles/layouts/mail/` to `/framework/borrowed/` and the real address died. [Demo](/imagine/gallery/answers/import/)

**2 · The card goes home.** `nav()` returns the page's own url, so clicking a borrowed card left `/imagine/gallery/answers/click/` for `/framework/core/Page/overview/columns/`. Nothing intervened — it is an ordinary `<a href>`. A wall of borrowed cards is a directory, not a navigation system. [Demo](/imagine/gallery/answers/click/)

**3 · One field takes the click away.** `preview(nav)` takes the nav as an argument: `{...nav, url: "/mine/"}` re-addresses the card, `{...nav, url: undefined}` emits an `<a>` with no href, which `Router.link_clicked()`'s `closest("a[href]")` never claims. Proven: the url never changed and my handler fired. [Demo](/imagine/gallery/answers/quiet/)

**4 · Give them urls of your own.** `route(name)` returns a spec whose `content()` calls the foreign page's own `content()` with it as `this` — read, never moved. Four building-block demos renamed and re-ordered under `/imagine/gallery/answers/arrange/`; each cold-loads at its own url with the gallery crumbs and rail intact, and the originals still work. [Demo](/imagine/gallery/answers/arrange/)

![the arrangement, at my urls](a4-arrange-1920-light.png)

**The card restyle.** The surface is painted in `core/Page/Page.css` — a sibling owns that file today, so the whole change ships scoped to `.gal-flat` with a before/after: [Cards](/imagine/gallery/cards/). Lifting those four rules unscoped is the site-wide change; the exact CSS and the two `light-dark()` tokens are in this log.

![before and after, light](cards-1920-light.png)
![before and after, dark](cards-1920-dark.png)

**Two bugs found, neither mine to fix.** A column marked `classes: "default"` that is also navigated to **hides itself** (Page.css matches it against itself once the Router marks it — the whole branch went blank). And `View.href(undefined)` falls into `attr()`'s getter branch and returns `null`, so `ext/demo`'s preview override throws on a url-less nav.

**Verified.** 12 pages x 400/1920/3440 x light+dark, zero console errors, no horizontal overflow; palette wall still 29/29.

**Left.** Two one-line relays: the Page.css restyle, and `previews` added to `core/Page/page.js`'s `notes:` so the doc joins the Docs rail (its url already resolves via the `.md` fallback). Not attempted: making one page render in two places at once — `render()` caches a single `view`, which is the real obstacle to "everything is a page".
